name: No More Beat Pulses
description: Reduces distractions by removing pulsing obj.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master toggle for all pulse suppression.

disable-gameplay-pulses.name: Disable Gameplay Object Pulses
disable-gameplay-pulses.description: Disables automatic idle beat pulsing on orb / ring style gameplay objects.

disable-decoration-pulses.name: Disable Pulsing Decoration
disable-decoration-pulses.description: Disables automatic beat pulsing on deco families such as lightsquares, lighttriangles, and light blocks.
